note: Issue #25: how bodies fall (src/systems/anim/ragdoll.gd). Speeds are m/s, gravity m/s^2 (the game's 20). kick is the push of the killing blow away from whoever landed it, scaled by its damage up to kick_max; kick_up lifts it a little so the body leaves its feet. knee_buckle pushes the knees forward so legs fold. friction and bounce act where a particle touches the world (collision_mask). It sleeps once nothing moves faster than sleep_speed for sleep_after seconds, or after max_seconds. Dropped weapons are thrown with the hand's speed plus weapon_toss. A kill with the energy sword flings the whole body along the blade's sweep at blade_fling (m/s), lifted by blade_fling_up, so it goes flying a few metres sideways. Droids cut down by the sword go the same way as one rigid piece (droid_mass kg), tumbling end over end at droid_tumble rad/s.
blast_note: Issue #372: a grenade kill throws the body away from the burst at blast_fling m/s at the edge of its radius, up to blast_fling_close m/s right on top of it, lifted by blast_fling_up times that speed (harder than any bolt kill, whose kick tops out at kick_max).
